seo.title: Weigh Easy — Track Your Weight, Privately
seo.description: A simple, private weight tracker for iOS. Log your weight, track trends, set goals, record body measurements, and capture progress photos. No accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions.

hero.label: WEIGHT TRACKING
hero.title: Track your weight, privately.
text: A simple weight tracker that respects your privacy. Log entries, see trends, set goals — all stored locally on your device.

sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

items.title: Weight Logging
items.text: Quick, one-tap entry for your daily weight. Add notes for context. See your history at a glance.

items.title: Trend Charts
items.text: Beautiful visualizations of your progress over time. Weekly, monthly, and all-time views with moving averages.

items.title: Goal Tracking
items.text: Set a target weight and track your progress toward it. Clear, motivating feedback on how far you've come.

items.title: Body Measurements
items.text: Track more than just weight. Log waist, chest, hips, arms, and other measurements to see the full picture.

items.title: Progress Photos
items.text: Capture visual progress over time. Compare side-by-side. Photos stay on your device — never uploaded anywhere.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: No accounts. No cloud sync. No network requests. Everything stays on your device, encrypted by iOS.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your body, your data.
text: Weight data is deeply personal. Weigh Easy never collects, uploads, or shares your information. No analytics. No tracking. No cloud. Everything stays on your device.

cta.title: Start tracking today.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
